title: Prime Minister congratulates Indian Women’s Squash Team on winning Bronze at Asian Games 2026
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated the Indian Women’s Squash Team on winning the Bronze medal at the Asian Games 2026.
The Prime Minister praised the team for its spirited effort and said that the players displayed great resolve to secure a richly deserved place on the podium.
Shri Modi said that the success will also motivate youngsters towards squash, which is becoming popular in India.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Proud of the Indian Women’s Squash Team for winning the Bronze Medal at the Asian Games 2026. Congrats to them for a spirited effort. They played with great resolve and secured a richly deserved place on the podium. This success will also motivate youngsters towards squash, which is becoming popular in India: PM @narendramodi”
